note: Laws in force on 1 January 2000; these are gameplay classifications. Economy: largely state-owned economy with limited privatisation. Press: state broadcasting dominant, independent print press under pressure. Elections: held, but the President's control of the state and media tilted competition; opposition parties boycotted the 2000 parliamentary election. Conscription: universal male service. Religion: secular state. Healthcare: tax-funded state system inherited from the USSR.
